phase3_verify_input_integrity_io.py.description: Phase-3 input integrity script: scans DAPI/stain TIFF folders, pairs by F####, validates 20 one-to-one 3D pairs (readability, shape/axes/dtype/Z/XY consistency), extracts TIFF/ImageJ/OME calibration metadata without unit assumptions, writes per-field manifest CSV and JSON/TXT summaries with downstream safety flag.

phase4a_preprocess_dapi_F0003_for_micro_.description: Preprocesses F0003 DAPI ZYX stack for later 3D micro_sam detection via conservative drift-aware haze correction and global robust normalization; saves float32 0-1 TIFF, QC PNG, and JSON metadata with parameters/percentiles.

phase4b_preprocess_soma_stain_F0003_for_.description: Preprocess F0003 soma-stain 3D stack for micro_sam: conservative whole-volume haze correction, optional tiny-scale puncta denoise, global robust normalization, and save TIFF+metadata JSON+QC PNG (including low-signal slice).

history.description: Preprocess F0003 soma-stain 3D stack with conservative whole-volume haze correction and robust normalization for later micro_sam segmentation; export corrected TIFF, metadata JSON, and QC PNG.

phase4c_pilot_segment_F0003_dapi_nuclei_.description: Fix undefined aliases in micro_sam pilot script by adding explicit imports for numpy (np) and other used aliases (os, pandas, matplotlib) required in napari-mcp env.

history.description: Pilot true-3D micro_sam AIS nuclei segmentation for F0003 DAPI with GPU, tiny-object filtering, border flags, QC overlays, per-object CSV, uint32 label TIFF, and metadata JSON.

Pilot true-3D micro_sam AIS nuclei segmentation on preprocessed F0003 DAPI (GPU/cuda, vit_b_lm, min-voxel filter=25) with uint32 label TIFF, per-object CSV (centroid/bbox/border flag/provisional um3), QC overlays, and metadata JSON.

phase4d_pilot_segment_F0003_soma_micro_s.description: Pilot F0003 soma-marker micro_sam 3D AIS segmentation (vit_b_lm on CUDA) with conservative min-volume filter=300 voxels, uint32 labels, per-object border-aware measurements, and QC overlays (lowest/low/mid/high-signal planes + XY MIP).

history.description: Pilot true-3D micro_sam AIS segmentation for F0003 soma-marker stack with conservative size filtering, per-object measurement CSV, metadata JSON, and QC overlays.

phase4e_revise_F0003_soma_upper_size_fil.description: Pilot F0003 soma post-processing revision: apply size-only filter (keep 300<=voxel_volume<=derived max via robust log-MAD/Tukey), relabel sequentially, regenerate per-object CSV with centroids/bboxes/border flags/provisional um3, emit removed-object report and metadata JSON, and save before-vs-after QC overlays for z10/z26/z56/z77 plus XY MIP.

phase4f_batch_segment_20_fields_micro_sa.description: Add per-field output inventory and field-wise status table to batch summary JSON for explicit 20/20 status and output listing.

history.description: Batch 3D preprocessing + micro_sam AIS segmentation for 20 DAPI/stain pairs with per-field labels, object measurements, QC overlays, resumable checkpoints, and aggregate summaries.

Resumable napari-mcp batch script: preprocess DAPI/soma stacks with approved fixed settings, run true-3D micro_sam AIS, apply nuclei>=25 and soma 300-18310 voxel filters, save per-field outputs/QC/metadata and aggregate nuclei+soma+counts+summary files.

phase4g_stage1_statistics_counts_ratios_.description: Stage 1 stats for 20 paired fields: verify all field_status=ok, compute field-level count descriptives, Pearson+95% CI and Spearman associations (total/nonborder), ratio summaries with bootstrap median CI (n_boot=10000), soma voxel-volume object-level and field-median summaries; saves Statistics_Results.csv plus field_counts_with_safe_ratios.csv, missingness_report.csv, iqr_outlier_report.csv, soma_voxel_volume_object_level_summary.csv, soma_field_median_iqr_by_field.csv; no plotting.

phase4h_stage2_publication_plots_counts_.description: Stage-2 plotting: move Figure 3 Pearson/Spearman annotation to an external right-margin box via fig.text + expanded layout; preserve all data/statistics, line/CI, labels, filenames, and PNG(300 DPI)+SVG exports for all 4 figures.

history.description: Stage-2 plotting script: reads Statistics_Results.csv + supporting field/object tables, renders 4 publication figures (counts panels, ratio panels with bootstrap median CI from stats CSV, annotated count-count scatter, soma voxel-volume distribution + field median/IQR panel), colorblind palette, 300 DPI PNG + SVG to figures/.
